'''Malcolm Dallory''' was the father of [[Shella Rinou]] and the captain of a fleet of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. He employed the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Kelric (Herglic)|Kelric]] as a troubleshooter for his trading empire.
